description: This file defines the BackendDebugHandleManager class and related types for managing debug handles and debug info mapping in PyTorch JIT backend. It includes documentation on the purpose and usage of debug handles, debug info, and associated APIs.

classes.name: BackendDebugInfoRecorder
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and managing debug handles and debug info map during backend processing.

methods.name: getNextDebugHandle
methods.description: Returns a unique debug handle for a given Node.

methods.name: stopRecording
methods.description: Stops debug info recording and returns the debug info map.

methods.name: generate_debug_handles
methods.description: Generates debug handles for nodes in a graph.
